benchmark_id: SQLIQ NIST SP 800-52 Rev. 2 SQL TLS review profile
provenance: SQLIQ-authored assessment aid; reviewed against NIST and Microsoft sources on 2026-10-06. SQLIQ IDs are not official NIST control IDs. NIST publication page has a review notice; verify the adopted revision at assessment time.
scope: 18 section-level review items covering server sections 3.1-3.8, client sections 4.1-4.8 and applicability of appendices C and D. Not an exhaustive clause register, official NIST control catalog, automated scan or certification. Review all applicable source clauses before assigning any item PASS.

controls.title: Server protocol support
controls.requirement: SQLIQ review task: map all applicable clauses of NIST SP 800-52 Rev. 2 3.1 to the exact SQL service and client implementation. The publication is authoritative; this task is not a substitute for its clauses.
checks: Record the SQL service, region, endpoint, minimum TLS setting, supported protocols and dated TDS-aware connection evidence for each application path. Distinguish supported, permitted and negotiated protocols.

Retain clause-by-clause applicability, evidence IDs and timestamps, accountable owner, reviewer and recommendation in the private evidence package. Unresolved clauses prevent a PASS for this review item.
fixes: Plan compatible service and driver upgrades; test TLS 1.3 support and enforce the approved protocol policy only through a separately approved change.
